A Message from CandidPay
Thank you for the warm welcome and the opportunity to walk through Crystal Lake Country Club with your leadership team. With over 100 years of history and a newly completed capital improvement, it is clear that CLCC is committed to delivering an exceptional experience for its members — and your payment infrastructure should reflect that same standard.

This overview summarizes what we observed during our visit, the modernization opportunities we identified, and our recommended path forward. Notably, based on our initial assessment, your current processor is charging significantly more than industry-standard rates — and we intend to show you exactly how much with a full statement analysis. Our goal is simple: make every transaction across your club seamless, secure, and meaningfully less expensive.

What You're Paying Today vs. CandidPay
After reviewing four months of processing statements (December 2025 – March 2026), CandidPay identified that Crystal Lake Country Club is being charged an all-in effective rate of 5.74% through Merchant Services / Heartland on a tiered pricing model — roughly 2.5–3× what a club of this profile should pay. The three biggest cost drivers are a processor markup that nearly mirrors interchange, a $124.99/month fee with no transparent value, and a 2.1% AMEX markup stacked on top of wholesale rates.

⚑
BASC STAND fee: $124.99/month ($1,499.88/year) — Charged every month with no clear value. This is the largest controllable non-processing cost on the account and is eliminated entirely with CandidPay.
⚑
Processor markup nearly equals interchange ($1,259 vs. $1,442) — An 87% markup-to-interchange ratio is a hallmark of abusive tiered pricing. Standard rate is 0.20%–0.40%. Estimated excess cost: $850–$1,050/month.
⚑
Effective rate hit 6.69% in March — Fixed fees of $149.12/month are punishing during low-volume months. CandidPay's lower fixed-cost structure protects the club during off-season.
⚑
AMEX markup stacked at ~2.1% above wholesale — AMEX averaged $6,414/month in volume. CandidPay's OptBlue program drops that markup to 0.5–0.8%, saving $55–$80/month.

How CandidPay Improves the CLCC Experience
💳
Seamless, Modern Payment at Every Bar & Zone
Replace aging Ingenico hardware with Dejavoo terminals purpose-built for hospitality environments. Staff at every bar — including the Eagle Room — can process cards instantly without leaving their station.
🔁
Tip Adjustment After Service
CandidPay supports post-transaction tip entry — something your current system doesn't allow. Wait staff can finalize gratuities naturally at the end of service, improving both the member experience and staff income.
📆
Recurring Membership Billing — Automated
Members can enroll in automatic annual billing via ACH or card-on-file. We can even build in a small member discount as an enrollment incentive. This eliminates manual dues collection and reduces administrative overhead significantly.
🔒
Fully Secure & Compliant Across Every Location
Every terminal in our solution is PCI-compliant and tokenized. No more card numbers written on paper, no manual workarounds, and no compliance exposure. Your members' payment data is always protected.
⚙️
GolfEssentials Integration — Native, Not Bolted On
By establishing a VAR partnership with GolfEssentials, CandidPay integrates directly into the software your team already knows. Payments flow natively — no parallel systems, no re-keying, no friction.

GolfEssentials Integration — Our Path Forward
⛳
GolfEssentials × CandidPay

CandidPay manages the entire partnership process on your behalf.
